title: Escalation Routing Rule R-010: Bed unavailable in requested ward
content:
ROUTING RULE: R-010 -- Bed unavailable in requested ward
TRIGGER TYPE: Data State
CONDITION: No vacant beds matching admission
ROUTE TO: Operations Management (Extension 1032)
QUEUE: QUEUE_FACILITY
PRIORITY: HIGH
SLA: 1.0 hour(s)
ESCALATION RATIONALE: Requires buffer override or inter-ward transfer by Operations Manager ext. 1032.
EXAMPLE QUERY 1: Zero ICU beds available for emergency patient
EXAMPLE QUERY 2: Need General Ward bed but all 15 occupied
